_readme: Real, comprehensive testing checklist covering everything built this session, grounded directly in BuildLog.md rather than memory. 'tested' starts false everywhere — fill it in as you go. 'howToReach' tells you the actual real path to the feature; 'whatToCheck' is the specific, real behavior that should happen, not just 'does it open'.

items.feature: Left Drawer — the top-left menu, all OmniProducts
items.howToReach: Click the top-left drawer handle
items.whatToCheck: OmniDraw, OmniChat, OmniTranslator, OmniSystem*, OmniMixer, OmniPocket, OmniNavi all listed and clickable

items.howToReach: Top bar, Assistance category
items.whatToCheck: Keyboard Shortcuts panel opens, list is accurate (includes 't' for OmniTranslator)

items.howToReach: Open any real text input (OmniLog editor, Jsonifier's JSON box) and type the letters r, f, t, backtick, and Escape while focused
items.whatToCheck: None of these should move the camera, open the terminal, or exit fullscreen while you're actually typing

items.howToReach: Open the Start Menu HUD, hover a quadrant, click its maximize (⛶) button
items.whatToCheck: That quadrant fills the whole HUD container (not full browser), other three hide, click again restores all four

items.howToReach: Press 'n', pick Static
items.whatToCheck: Live shape preview, spawns a real node

items.howToReach: Press 'n', pick Dynamic
items.whatToCheck: Real ticker/dynamic text node spawns

items.howToReach: Press 'n', pick Jsonifier
items.whatToCheck: Theme picker (black/white/grey) affects spawned node color by depth; classification via a real '_classification' key in your JSON produces a colored highlight ring (green=truth, red=false, none=neutral)

items.howToReach: Press 'n', pick OmniCell
items.whatToCheck: Standalone creation panel works

items.howToReach: Press 'n', pick Chat
items.whatToCheck: OmniChat opens with Text/JSON/Terminal tabs

items.howToReach: Press 'n', pick Log
items.whatToCheck: OmniLog editor opens; try the Lorem Ipsum button in the page-options area to force multiple real pages; RGBA color picker affects the actual page background

items.howToReach: OmniLog editor, transform section
items.whatToCheck: Typing an exact number in the field updates the matching slider and vice versa

items.howToReach: Right-click any node, including an existing OmniLog page
items.whatToCheck: On a regular node: opens Inspector. On an OmniLog entry: reopens the actual editor pre-filled, and resubmitting updates the same entry rather than creating a duplicate

items.howToReach: Right-click any node's quick menu
items.whatToCheck: Node disappears from scene, appears in OmniPocket panel

items.howToReach: Open Start Menu HUD, Q2 (top-right)
items.whatToCheck: Header shows hovered item's title; drag to reorder persists; preview button shows JSON tree/data/dynamic string depending on node type; Take Out reinstates the node live

items.howToReach: Press 't'
items.whatToCheck: Left/Right vaults sit in the real gap between the top and bottom Hand corners, not overlapping the Start Menu

items.howToReach: Right-click any OmniDraw element's quick menu
items.whatToCheck: Vault picker sub-menu adds the item to the chosen side

items.howToReach: Admin panel, slot 12
items.whatToCheck: Start Selecting, click floor cells, they highlight white with yellow outline; Save Context creates a real, listed, loadable named context with an in-scene grid wireframe boundary

items.howToReach: Admin panel, slot 14
items.whatToCheck: Points snap to grid vertices, not cell centers; nexus label shows world position + cell index; local subdivision densifies just one cell; raising a wall on north/south/east/west grows a real vertical grid from that edge

items.howToReach: Admin panel, slot 13
items.whatToCheck: Marker position and number update live as you change camera height

items.howToReach: Open Start Menu HUD, Q4 (bottom-right)
items.whatToCheck: Shows real node dots, the landing-point marker, and staged grid contexts as yellow regions, all scaled to fit whatever actually exists

items.howToReach: Click anywhere on the Q4 minimap
items.whatToCheck: Camera flies to that real world location

items.howToReach: Developer menu, slot 1
items.whatToCheck: Try ⟐help, ⟐ls, ⟐create BoxGeometry test, ⟐cd <id>, ⟐inspect, ⟐present, ⟐pocket — typing without the leading ⟐ still works

items.howToReach: Developer menu, slot 2, or ⟐OmniNavi in the Left Drawer
items.whatToCheck: Building spawns a real OmniBotProgram with cube head, embedded panel, sphere body, and a separate stateCommunicator sphere above the head; Basic tier idles with a continuous bob+spin

items.howToReach: Developer menu, slot 3
items.whatToCheck: Live camera position, orbit-enabled state, pressed directions

items.howToReach: Developer menu, slot 4
items.whatToCheck: Every one of the 13 emotion buttons visibly changes the camera-attached particles' color and motion; standing still vs. moving changes Normal Walking/Dash density

items.howToReach: Look at all four screen corners
items.whatToCheck: omnihand (TL), conscious (TR), lh (BL), rh (BR) all render with their real hamburger/pad/orbiter/radial cells

items.howToReach: Enable OmniChronos, look into the RootSpace tunnel
items.whatToCheck: The traveling reality-node disc should be invisible until a real texture/video is actually set on it — no more opaque white circle by default

items.howToReach: Admin panel, various slots
items.whatToCheck: Each opens its real panel

items.howToReach: Select any non-group node, open Inspector
items.whatToCheck: A Sequence Node toggle and a Focus/Free camera-mode select appear; toggling on wireframes the node once as a first-time default

items.howToReach: Connect a Sequence Node to a second target node via a new sequence edge
items.whatToCheck: The old outgoing sequence edge is automatically removed — a Sequence Node never has two

items.howToReach: Build a short chain of Sequence Nodes, open OmniPresenter
items.whatToCheck: It finds the true head of the chain and walks it in order, matching the amber/dashed sequence edges, not the generic path system

items.feature: Focus vs Free camera mode on arrival
items.howToReach: Set one chain node to Focus, another to Free, run the Presenter through both
items.whatToCheck: Focus mode does NOT re-enable orbit on arrival (camera stays locked on the node); Free mode does

items.howToReach: OmniDraw, set isSequenceNode + cameraMode, Export to Scene
items.whatToCheck: The spawned real node has both fields set correctly, not defaulted

items.howToReach: Map Settings panel, new 'MiniMap Visible' row (above 'Visible on Start')
items.whatToCheck: Toggling it immediately shows/hides the live minimap, distinct from 'Visible on Start' which only affects next launch

items.howToReach: With Map Settings open, toggle the minimap via the 'm' key instead of the panel
items.whatToCheck: The panel's checkbox updates to match, not left stale

items.howToReach: OmniDraw, set Wireframe on, Alpha below 1, a non-default Material type, then Export to Scene
items.whatToCheck: The real spawned node reflects all three — previously these were silently dropped on export (preview-only bug), only the embedded preview mesh showed them

items.howToReach: Reload the page after exporting a node with those flags set
items.whatToCheck: Restore path re-applies the same flags via the shared _applyAppearanceFlags helper — no drift between fresh creation and restore

items.howToReach: Click the ▲ button in the Dock's right wing
items.whatToCheck: Tray slides open/closed; button shows an active state while open

items.howToReach: Minimize any panel
items.whatToCheck: A titled tab appears in the Tray's row 1

items.howToReach: Minimize OmniChronos, OmniKeys, or AdminPanel specifically — these never had a working restore before this build — then click their Tray tab
items.whatToCheck: The panel genuinely reappears and comes to front; previously only ~5 of 40+ panels could be restored at all

items.howToReach: Header toolbar orientation buttons
items.whatToCheck: Tray re-docks cleanly to bottom/top/left/right with no inverted row order; below 560px width, left/right auto-fall back to bottom

items.howToReach: Header toolbar Expand/Collapse
items.whatToCheck: Reveals/hides row 2 then row 3 in order

items.howToReach: Drag a tab within or between rows
items.whatToCheck: Tab moves to the new position/row and stays there

items.howToReach: Right-click (or long-press) a tab
items.whatToCheck: Maximize / Close / Move Left / Move Right / Move to Row N all work; 'Close' is non-destructive, same as the old orb's Dismiss, not a delete

items.howToReach: Header toolbar
items.whatToCheck: Filter cycles present ⟐ categories; Sort (Manual/Alphabetical/By Date/By ⟐) actually redistributes tabs across rows, row 1 filling first; Search matches by label substring

items.howToReach: Set a non-default orientation/sort/header-visible state, reload the page
items.whatToCheck: Those three persist; the actual minimized-tab list intentionally does NOT persist (no panel tracks that as its own state yet) — stale tabs after reload would be the wrong behavior, not a bug

items.howToReach: Hold right mouse button on the 3D canvas and drag
items.whatToCheck: Camera pans (shifts what's centered), doesn't just rotate

items.feature: No stray node context menu after a pan
items.howToReach: Right-click-drag starting or ending over a node mesh
items.whatToCheck: The node's quick menu does NOT pop open just because the release happened to land on it — only a right-click with no real drag (<~6px) should open it

items.howToReach: Look at the LH (bottom-left) and RH (bottom-right) movement pads
items.whatToCheck: 3 small buttons on each pad's own rim — Release, Dash (⟫⟫), and a dimmed TBD slot; LH cluster in the lower-right arc of its circle, RH mirrored in the lower-left arc of its circle

items.howToReach: Click Release on either pad
items.whatToCheck: The pad's cross AND its 3 satellites all become draggable together, dragged by the pad's own header text

items.howToReach: With a pad detached and dragged somewhere, click Release again
items.whatToCheck: The whole group animates back to its original corner

items.feature: Dash still works from its new spot
items.howToReach: Click the Dash button inside the LH satellite cluster
items.whatToCheck: LH (WASD) movement speed multiplies, same as before — only its position changed

items.howToReach: Detach a pad, drag it, reload the page (same browser)
items.whatToCheck: It comes back detached, at the same position

items.howToReach: Drag the ⟐ icon (default: top-center)
items.whatToCheck: Moves freely, stays where dropped, persists across reload

items.howToReach: Click (don't drag) the ⟐ icon
items.whatToCheck: A small radial popup fans out near it with a '⌨ Keyboard' option

items.howToReach: Click the Keyboard option in the popup
items.whatToCheck: The CryptxMode panel appears docked at the right edge, collapsed to its header

items.howToReach: Open via the ⟐ Quick Launcher's Keyboard option
items.whatToCheck: Only the meta header is visible against the right edge, no columns yet

items.feature: MX Ergo top/bottom arrow reveals/retracts a column (keyboard open)
items.howToReach: With CryptxMode open, press the MX Ergo's dedicated top arrow button
items.whatToCheck: One more vertical column appears (Control first, then letter rows, then digits, then symbols), pulling the panel further left; the other arrow button retracts the most recent one

items.feature: Same buttons control height when keyboard is closed
items.howToReach: With CryptxMode closed, press the MX Ergo's top/bottom arrow buttons
items.whatToCheck: Camera rises/falls (same as pressing R/F), confirming the mode-scoped mapping actually switches

items.feature: Scroll wheel moves selection within the active column
items.howToReach: With at least one column revealed, scroll over the panel
items.whatToCheck: Highlight moves up/down within the most-recently-revealed column only, wrapping at the ends; the column auto-scrolls if the highlight goes off-screen

items.howToReach: Click a highlighted or any character cell, with a real text input focused somewhere
items.whatToCheck: That character is actually typed into the focused input

items.howToReach: Right-click anywhere on the CryptxMode panel
items.whatToCheck: Retracts the most recently revealed column, same as the MX Ergo's retract button

items.howToReach: Middle-click the CryptxMode panel
items.whatToCheck: Panel closes entirely

items.howToReach: Reveal the Symbols column (6th reveal) on a short browser window
items.whatToCheck: That column scrolls on its own if taller than the panel, without affecting other revealed columns

items.howToReach: Click the ⟐ icon (now defaulting to the bottom Dock's dead-center, like a home button)
items.whatToCheck: Radial popup with 'Keyboard' opens immediately on click; previously did nothing at all

items.howToReach: Clear localStorage (or a fresh browser profile) and reload
items.whatToCheck: ⟐ icon spawns centered horizontally, vertically centered inside the bottom Dock bar — not floating near the top anymore

items.howToReach: Drag the launcher elsewhere, reload the page (same browser)
items.whatToCheck: Launcher reopens at the dragged position, not snapping back to the Dock default

items.feature: Dash button lights up and actually speeds LH movement
items.howToReach: Click the Dash satellite button on the LH pad, then move with WASD
items.whatToCheck: Button glows bright/active immediately on click; LH movement speed visibly multiplies while active

items.feature: Release button visibly shows detached state
items.howToReach: Click the Release satellite button on either pad
items.whatToCheck: Release button itself now glows/lights up (not just a subtle pad box-shadow change), header becomes grabbable, pad can be dragged anywhere

items.howToReach: With a pad detached and dragged elsewhere, click Release again
items.whatToCheck: Pad (and its satellites) animate back to the original docked corner position, Release button un-lights

categories.category: KryptxKeyboard entry in OmniKeys top menu (V149)

items.howToReach: Open ⟐OmniKeys, look at the top menu row (first button, before Edit/Delivery/Sequence/Command)
items.whatToCheck: Clicking 'KryptxKeyboard' opens the CryptxMode vertical keyboard from the right edge, independent of whether the ⟐ Quick Launcher works

items.howToReach: Open OmniMeter from the nav drawer (replaces the old OmniVerticalMeter entry)
items.whatToCheck: Vertical track (right edge), Horizontal track (top edge), and Depth line (top-to-center) all appear and their markers move as the camera moves on Y/X/Z respectively

items.howToReach: Click the small ⚙ button near the top-right
items.whatToCheck: Unchecking an axis hides just that one indicator; the other two stay visible

items.howToReach: In the same settings popover, click the 'Labels:' button
items.whatToCheck: Toggles between 'Horiz / Vert / Depth' and 'X / Y / Z' naming

items.howToReach: Fly the camera far along any axis
items.whatToCheck: Marker clamps at the track's end around +/-525 from center rather than running off/disappearing

items.feature: Two nodes move and trail afterimages
items.howToReach: Look for two glowing spheres moving through the scene
items.whatToCheck: Each leaves a visible trail of fading/shrinking ghost copies behind it as it moves on X/Y/Z

items.feature: Click locks the camera on, Zelda-style
items.howToReach: Click directly on one of the moving nodes
items.whatToCheck: Camera smoothly follows the node as it moves; the existing Z-Targeting reticle (tetrahedron markers) appears around it; OrbitControls stop responding to drag while locked

items.feature: Click again (or click empty space) releases the lock
items.howToReach: While locked on, click the same node again, or click empty space
items.whatToCheck: Camera stops following, free orbit control returns, the targeting reticle disappears

items.feature: OmniHand (top-left) is a real MOVE pad
items.howToReach: Click OmniHand's own ⚇ button (top-left corner), or press Numpad / * - +
items.whatToCheck: A real cross with FWD/BCK/STR-L/STR-R appears (not a dimmed TBD cross); clicking or pressing the numpad operator keys translates the camera, mirroring LH's WASD feel

items.feature: ConsciousHand (top-right) is a real NAV pad
items.howToReach: Click ConsciousHand's own ⚇ button (top-right corner), or press Numpad7/Numpad9
items.whatToCheck: A real cross with RISE/FALL/ORB-L/ORB-R appears; Numpad7/9 move altitude up/down, left/right pad buttons orbit-yaw, mirroring RH's R/F feel

items.feature: Satellite clusters on both new pads
items.howToReach: Look at the rim of OmniHand/ConsciousHand's pads once visible
items.whatToCheck: Release button works (detach/re-dock, same as LH/RH); Dash button is present but visually inert (reserved) on both, same as RH already was

items.feature: Radial Tool menu content now mirrors LH/RH
items.howToReach: Open OmniHand's Tool radial (page ⟐2) and compare to LH's; same for ConsciousHand vs RH
items.whatToCheck: OmniHand's tool list matches LH's (Translate3D, Rotate3D, Scale3D, ...); ConsciousHand's matches RH's (ColorShift, MaterialMorph, ...)

items.feature: Tool radial menu visible over an open pad
items.howToReach: Toggle OmniHand's pad on (⚇ button or numpad keys), then open OmniHand's own Tool radial (⟐2 page); repeat for ConsciousHand, and spot-check LH/RH too
items.whatToCheck: The radial popup renders ON TOP of the pad, fully visible and clickable, not hidden behind it

items.feature: Satellites fade in with their pad
items.howToReach: Toggle any of the 4 hands' pads on from fully closed
items.whatToCheck: Release + Dash/reserved satellite buttons fade in together with the pad, not already sitting there beforehand

items.feature: Satellites fade out with their pad
items.howToReach: Toggle a pad off while it's open
items.whatToCheck: Satellites fade out together with the pad, not left floating on screen after the pad disappears

items.feature: LH's 3 satellite buttons present and working
items.howToReach: Toggle LH's pad on
items.whatToCheck: Release, Dash, and the reserved slot all appear on LH's rim and are clickable (Release detaches, Dash toggles speed boost)

items.feature: Three gears visible and layered correctly
items.howToReach: Open ⟐p OmniPresenter (press 'p' or use its menu entries)
items.whatToCheck: White gear reads as the furthest-back/faintest layer, gold in the middle, solarSystem nearest the text — all three visible behind the panel's text/controls without hurting readability

items.howToReach: Watch the panel background for ~10 seconds
items.whatToCheck: White, gold, and solarSystem each rotate at their own speed; gold turns the opposite direction from the other two

items.howToReach: Use the sequence list, transport buttons, speed slider, close/minimize/attach controls
items.whatToCheck: Everything works exactly as before — the background change didn't break any click targets or bindings

items.howToReach: Press 'g', or click the Gallery button inside any node's Inspector > Appearance > Texture slot
items.whatToCheck: ⟐g OmniGallery panel slides in from the bottom-left above the Dock and slides back out on close, without overlapping OmniPresenter's own bottom-right panel

items.howToReach: Open OmniGallery and look at the left-hand tree
items.whatToCheck: Top level shows 'ToBeSorted' first (expandable, empty), then 'SystemAssets' second; expanding SystemAssets shows 'Geometries', and expanding that shows one folder per real node geometry type (Box, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Torus, TorusKnot, Octahedron, Tetrahedron, Icosahedron, Dodecahedron, Plane, Circle, Ring, Capsule, Lathe, Tube, Extrude, Shape, Edges, Wireframe)

items.feature: Plane and Box folders show all 13 textures
items.howToReach: Click the 'Plane' folder, then the 'Box' folder
items.whatToCheck: Both folders list all 13 swatches (lotus emblem, 3 panel-square variants, 3 nested-square variants, connector bar, blueprint grid corner, technical corner frame, schematic burst emblem, quadrant schematic pattern, dashed rule pair) and every thumbnail actually renders the image, not a broken-image icon

items.feature: Other geometry folders are real but empty
items.howToReach: Click any geometry folder other than Plane or Box (e.g. Sphere, Torus)
items.whatToCheck: Folder opens with an empty-state message ('No textures in this folder yet.') rather than erroring or showing stale content from the previously selected folder

items.howToReach: Expand/collapse a few folders, select one, close the panel, reopen it (press 'g' twice)
items.whatToCheck: The same folders are still expanded and the same folder is still the active selection after reopening (persisted via localStorage)

items.feature: Keyboard shortcut 'g' doesn't collide with anything
items.howToReach: Press 'g' while NOT focused in a text input, then again while focused in a text input (e.g. a node's Label field)
items.whatToCheck: First press toggles OmniGallery; second press (while typing) types the letter 'g' into the field instead of toggling the panel

items.feature: Shortcut documented in ⟐ Keyboard Shortcuts panel
items.howToReach: Open the Keyboard Shortcuts panel from the Assistance dropdown
items.whatToCheck: A row reads "g — Toggle ⟐g OmniGallery"

items.feature: Inspector 'Gallery' button opens OmniGallery in select mode
items.howToReach: Select a node, open its Inspector, expand Appearance, find the Texture slot, click the '⟐g Gallery' button next to Apply
items.whatToCheck: OmniGallery opens with a visible 'Pick a texture' badge and a colored glow border indicating select mode is active

items.feature: Picking a texture from the gallery applies it to the selected mesh
items.howToReach: With a node selected and OmniGallery open in select mode (from the Inspector button), click any texture swatch
items.whatToCheck: OmniGallery closes automatically, the Inspector's texture preview/URL field updates to the picked asset's path, and the actual 3D mesh in the scene visibly gets that image as its material map

items.feature: Picking a texture with no node selected doesn't throw
items.howToReach: Deselect all nodes (omni:node-deselected), open OmniGallery directly with 'g', click a swatch
items.whatToCheck: omni:gallery-texture-select still fires (console/listener), no error is thrown, and nothing crashes since no mesh is currently loaded in the Inspector

items.howToReach: Use the Inspector's texture drop-zone, file picker, URL + Apply, and Clear texture controls as before
items.whatToCheck: All of this still works exactly as before the Gallery button was added — no regression in the existing texture flow

categories.category: Theme centralization, MiniMap off-by-default, Kryptx nudge, minimize-to-tab restore fix (V154)

items.feature: Blue accent still renders identically after centralization
items.howToReach: Open any of: AccountDashboardPanel, AccountLoginPanel, AccountProfilePanel, MiniMapSettingsPanel, OmniCommunicationPanel, OmniDraw, OmniDrawDynamic, OmniJsonifier, OmniKeys, OmniPanelTray, OmniStructurePanel, CameraTravelSettingsPanel, ToolTipSettingsPanel, OmniUserPanel, or the Inspector (OmniInspector)
items.whatToCheck: The blue accent (borders, hover glows, active states) looks exactly as before — same hue/opacity, no panel rendering unstyled or with a missing color (would show as transparent/black instead of blue if the var() token failed to resolve)

items.feature: Existing ThemeManager light/dark/custom switch still works
items.howToReach: Open AdminPanel's theme picker and switch between Dark, Light, and a custom color set
items.whatToCheck: Panels built on the --omni-theme-* hook (most SettingsPanels, Account* panels, OmniKeys, OmniDraw, AdminPanel itself) still re-color correctly — OmniTheme.js's new --omni-color-accent-blue token is independent of this system and was not supposed to touch it

items.feature: THREE.Color / canvas / chart colors unaffected by the theme pass
items.howToReach: In OmniDraw's Dynamic text tool, create a dynamic ticker node; check an emotional-state-driven player aura color (OmniPlayerGame); open OmniCellPanel and view a chart with multiple series
items.whatToCheck: The dynamic ticker node's sphere renders actual blue (not invisible/black/default material color), the player aura still tints correctly, and the chart's first series swatch is still blue — these three were deliberately kept as literal '#7fd8ff' hex (not var()) since THREE.Color/canvas/D3 can't resolve a CSS custom property

items.feature: MiniMap does not appear on a fresh load
items.howToReach: Clear localStorage (or use a fresh profile) and load the app
items.whatToCheck: The MiniMap is NOT visible in the top-right corner on load

items.feature: MiniMap can still be turned on live
items.howToReach: Press 'm', or open the MiniMap settings panel (Admin) and toggle its visibility switch
items.whatToCheck: The MiniMap appears/disappears live without needing a reload, exactly as before this change — only the startup default changed

items.feature: KryptxKeyboard ◂/▸ nudge buttons move the panel
items.howToReach: Open OmniKeys, click 'KryptxKeyboard' to open CryptxMode, then click the ◂ and ▸ buttons in its header
items.whatToCheck: ◂ moves the whole docked panel further left (away from the right screen edge) in 48px steps; ▸ moves it back toward the edge; ◂ disables once the panel's leftmost column would run off-screen, ▸ disables once back at the docked position (offset 0)

items.feature: Kryptx nudge offset persists and re-clamps
items.howToReach: Nudge the Kryptx panel out a few steps, reveal/retract columns, then reload the page and reopen CryptxMode
items.whatToCheck: The offset is restored from localStorage on reopen/reload, and revealing more columns (which widens the panel) re-clamps the offset so it can never push the panel off the left edge of the viewport

items.feature: Minimizing any panel sends it to the OmniPanelTray, not nowhere
items.howToReach: Open any panel (e.g. OmniNode, OmniPocket, OmniPresenter, OmniKeys, lh/rh side panels) and click its minimize ('_' or '–') control
items.whatToCheck: The panel disappears and a tab for it appears in the Dock's panel tray once opened (see next item) — it should NOT just vanish with no trace

items.feature: The Dock's ▲ arrow actually opens/closes the panel tray
items.howToReach: Click the small ▲ arrow in the Dock's far-right wing
items.whatToCheck: A tray of tabs slides open/closed along whichever edge it's currently oriented to (bottom by default); the arrow itself rotates 180° while the tray is open

items.feature: Clicking a tab actually restores its panel (the real bug fixed this version)
items.howToReach: Minimize OmniNode, OmniPocket, OmniPresenter, and an lh/rh side panel (ui/Panel.js), open the tray, and click each one's tab
items.whatToCheck: Each panel genuinely reappears (not just the tab disappearing with nothing coming back) — this exact case was broken before V154: WindowManager.restorePanel() returned early for unregistered ids and never dispatched omni:panel-restore, and OmniNode/OmniPocket/OmniPresenter were never registered with WindowManager at all

items.feature: Restoring a panel also works for every other panel type (regression check)
items.howToReach: Minimize a handful of IndexedPanel-based panels (e.g. any *SettingsPanel, AdminPanel, OmniChronos) via the tray and restore them
items.whatToCheck: No regression — these were already working via WindowManager registration before this pass and should still restore correctly

categories.category: MiniMap migration fix, Admin slot changes, OmniPointing/OmniStemming / OmniMeter(External) (V155)

items.feature: MiniMap no longer silently reverts to visible-on-start for a returning user
items.howToReach: In a browser that already has an old omni:minimap:settings blob saved (from before V154), load the page fresh
items.whatToCheck: The minimap starts hidden (the new code default), not visible — the one-time migration should have forced startVisible back to false while leaving your saved corner/showPortals untouched; check localStorage's omni:minimap:settings now has _v: 2

items.feature: MiniMap's own 'Visible on Start' toggle works normally after the migration
items.howToReach: Admin → MiniMapSettings (slot 4), toggle 'Visible on Start' on, reload the page
items.whatToCheck: The minimap now starts visible — your own explicit choice after the one-time migration is respected in either direction, it isn't forced back to false again

items.howToReach: Admin panel, slot 13
items.whatToCheck: Label reads 'OmniMeter(Internal)'; clicking it still opens the exact same OmniMeter panel as before

items.howToReach: Admin panel, slot 16
items.whatToCheck: Opens FloorManager, identical to its old slot 15 behavior

items.feature: Admin slot 15 — OmniMeter(External) toggles OmniPointing on/off
items.howToReach: Admin panel, slot 15
items.whatToCheck: Clicking it toggles OmniPointing active; hovering the floor only shows a tooltip/dots while active, and all overlays (tooltip, dots, stem preview) clear immediately when toggled off

items.feature: OmniPointing hover tooltip shows the real snapped coordinate
items.howToReach: With OmniMeter(External) active, move the mouse over the floor
items.whatToCheck: A small tooltip near the cursor shows (x, y, z) snapped to the real 20-unit grid, matching OmniRealityGridPointSelector's own grid; hovering a real node mesh instead shows no OmniPointing tooltip at all (OmniNode owns that cursor)

items.feature: Neighbor points fade in near the cursor, fade out with distance
items.howToReach: With OmniMeter(External) active, hover the floor and watch the small dots around the hovered point

items.feature: Group nesting depth cap (defensive, not expected to be hit in normal use)

items.howToReach: Click the ▾/▸ button on a Group row's header
items.whatToCheck: The nested step list hides/shows; the Group's collapsed state is NOT lost on the next render (re-open the Inspector section, or save/reload the node) — it's stored on the step itself

items.feature: Save + Run a program containing a Group with real nested steps (Move + Notify)

items.whatToCheck: All steps run in order, including the two nested inside the Group, with no gap or skip around the Group boundary — the object actually moves per the nested Move step and the nested Notify actually pushes a real OmniNotify message, before the final top-level Notify fires

items.feature: Auto-Persist still applies to a nested Move/Rotate/Scale step's end state

items.feature: Infinite repeat mode with a nested Group
